[sarahmcoleman.phd\@gmail.com](mailto:sarahmcoleman.phd@gmail.com) \| [sarahmcoleman.github.io](https://sarahmcoleman.github.io/) \| [linkedin.com/in/sarah-m-coleman](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sarah-m-coleman/)

## Summary

Bioprocess development engineer specializing in **upstream process development** and **fed-batch fermentation**, with upstream PD experience at **Bristol Myers Squibb** (biologics, CHO **cell culture**) and **Takeda** (vaccines, Vero cells). Background spans microbial strain and fermentation process development, downstream protein recovery, multi-omics analysis, and statistical modeling. PhD in Chemical Engineering and MS in Statistics, with experience in **scale-up**, **DoE**, and statistical analysis of experimental biology data in Python and R.

## Work Experience

**BioReNuva**, Austin, TX\
*Bioprocess Development Engineer* \| Jun 2026 – Present

- Established fed-batch fermentation capability for glycolipid production with *Pseudomonas* as subject-matter expert
- Designed and implemented the company's first fed-batch bioreactor process from scratch, including equipment selection, feed strategy, control parameters, and run protocols
- Defined key performance indicators (KPIs) and identified process bottlenecks, informing the scale-up roadmap
- Authored the bioreactor standard operating procedure (SOP) and batch records; trained team members on the process

**The University of Texas at Austin**, Austin, TX\
*Postdoctoral Research Fellow (Statistics and Data Sciences)* \| Oct 2024 – Sep 2026

- Developed epidemiological and statistical models of environmental-health data in Dr. Roger D. Peng's group
- Wrote first-author papers in *Environmental Research Communications*, *Environmental Health* (under review), and *CHANCE* (in press), the last from a first-place JSM Data Challenge Expo entry
- Advised medical faculty on statistical methodology

**The University of Texas at Austin**, Austin, TX\
*Lecturer (Statistics and Data Sciences)* \| Jan 2026 – Apr 2026

- Taught a 100-student upper-division data science and machine learning course as the instructor of record, rated 4.32/5 by students, above department, college, and university averages; managed 3 TAs

**The University of Texas at Austin**, Austin, TX\
*Graduate Research Fellow (Chemical Engineering)* \| Aug 2019 – Aug 2024

- Designed and ran batch *Yarrowia lipolytica* fermentations in 3 L bioreactors at up to 50% (v/v) waste cooking oil, among the highest loadings reported, with CFD modeling of scale-up to 4,000 L, published in *Biotechnology Journal*
- Developed media formulations, prepared inoculum, ran reactor sterilization and probe calibration, and tracked runs by optical density, dry cell weight, and HPLC for sugars and organic acids
- Designed factorial (DoE) screens of nitrogen source, nitrogen concentration, and substrate loading to optimize media for a yeast alkane-assimilation panel, analyzed by three-way ANOVA with post-hoc correction
- Increased *Y. lipolytica* tolerance to hydrothermal liquefaction wastewater from 10% to 30% (v/v) by adaptive laboratory evolution, yielding an isolate with nearly 3-fold higher titer of the high-value polyketide triacetic acid lactone while reducing COD (chemical oxygen demand), published in *Applied Microbiology and Biotechnology*
- Evolved *Y. lipolytica* for growth on high-density waste cooking oil (submitted to *Bioresource Technology*), characterized it by genomics, transcriptomics, and metabolomics, and engineered it to produce long-chain fatty alcohols
- Developed a genome editing system using Golden Gate assembly for targeted engineering of *Y. lipolytica*, and used this system to screen a native promoter library
- Proposed and validated a linear mixed-effects model to quantitatively evaluate the performance of biological Boolean logic gates for the first time, published in *ACS Synthetic Biology*
- Mentored 4 undergraduates and 2 junior PhD students; presented results to project sponsors and collaborators

## Technical Skills

- **Bioprocessing & Fermentation**: Batch and fed-batch microbial fermentation, bioreactor operation with DO and pH control (BioFlo/CelliGen with BioCommand, DeltaV), shake flask culture, high-throughput growth screening (BioLector, 96-well plates), OD600, dry cell weight, off-gas analysis, scale-up, kLa and mass transfer, media and feed development, seed train, tangential flow filtration (TFF), SOPs, batch records, tech transfer documentation
- **Synthetic Biology & Metabolic Engineering**: Metabolic engineering, genome editing (Golden Gate and Gibson assembly, CRISPR), plasmid design and cloning (*E. coli*), colony selection, strain engineering, promoter library screening, adaptive laboratory evolution
- **Cell Culture & Molecular Biology**: Yeast, bacterial, and mammalian (CHO, Vero) cell culture, aseptic technique, BSL-2 and BSL-2+, cGLP, recombinant protein expression (IPTG induction), 6xHis affinity chromatography, SDS-PAGE, Vi-CELL, Cedex Bio, NucleoCounter, flow cytometry, qPCR, protein purification, Western blotting
- **Computational Biology & Data Science**: Python, R, SQL, MATLAB, JMP, statistical modeling, machine learning, data visualization, DoE, CFD (Ansys CFX)
- **Bioinformatics & Omics**: RNA-seq and Tag-seq (DESeq2), genomic variant analysis, genome annotation, metabolomics, high-performance computing, Docker
- **Analytical Chemistry**: HPLC, LC-MS/MS, GC-MS, headspace GC, UV-Vis, assay development, plate reader assays
- **Software**: Benchling, LIMS, Linux, Bash, Git/GitHub, Jupyter, LaTeX, GraphPad Prism
